questions.prompt: What kind of security incident is this?

choices.description: The agent deleted, overwrote or reset data, files or infrastructure.
The agent read, listed or used secrets, keys or tokens.
The agent sent or copied data to a place outside the project.
The agent changed permissions, roles, policy files or its own limits.
The agent retried or rephrased a call after a deny to get around a rule.
The agent installed, fetched or ran code from an outside source.
The calls look like they follow instructions that came from tool output or fetched content.
The calls look like normal work, a test or a gate misconfiguration.

questions.prompt: How fast must a person look at this incident?

choices.description: Wake someone. Damage or loss may be in progress.
Someone must look in the next hour in working time.
Put it in the next daily summary.
No person needs to look at it.

questions.prompt: What is the best next step for a person?

choices.description: Rotate the secret or key that the agent may have seen.
Change the policy or never-list so this cannot repeat.

questions.prompt: Is this incident most likely harmless?
